prompt_prefix: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production architectural CAD repeating BASE COLOR / albedo texture. Generate ONE square 1024x1024 image of the described material filling every pixel edge to edge. Orthographic front-on surface scan with zero perspective, perfectly flat even diffuse illumination, no lighting gradient, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no reflections baked into color, no vignette. Opposite edges MUST match seamlessly for repetition in both directions. Fine photoreal material detail at stated physical scale, restrained contrast appropriate for architectural modelling. No text, labels, borders, collage, palette, objects, watermark or logos. Opaque RGB image; transparency will be material metadata. Subject:

assets.name: 木（明るい）
assets.subject_prompt: Light honey oak wood, natural fine straight grain flowing vertically, subtle pale growth rings, a few gentle organic variations, no plank joints, no knots with dramatic contrast. Warm golden beige oak, moderate saturation. Physical sample one metre square.

assets.name: 木（濃い）

assets.name: 漆喰（白）

assets.name: モルタル

assets.name: レンガ
